name: classic-geode
_comment: Canonical GEODE-mode Classic cycle for the trace harness and the Studio detach parity gate: GEODE_MODE with the default 1-dig fill. Toggle at 0; the dig leg settles PRE_DIG_SETTLE_MS then taps GEODE_DIG_MS at 80-85; the capacity jumps to FULL at 150 inside the GEODE_START_MS start window, the animation wait bails immediately on FULL, the judge counts the dig and breaks; go_water reaches the Pan cue at 300 inside the first budget; the geode-flavored shake (GEODE_SHAKE_HOLD_MS hold/bail, halved empty threshold, sense every GEODE_SHAKE_CHECK clicks) drains at 700 with momentum W; the quit lands inside the next dig's pre-settle, so the healthy golden carries zero safety events (the nudge path is covered by classic-geode-miss). Whole-box capacity paint is binary (see classic-shards), so 'a rise that is not yet FULL' is unrepresentable — the count-trust assume path and GEODE_CONFIRM_FULL are expressed by the materializer but not scenario-reachable; recorded in the Studio ledger. Lives in engine_goldens/classic_trace (NOT engine_scenarios/); vendored to the Studio.
_screen_comment: Whole-box capacity paint (see classic-shards): keyframes are 0/1 only.
